value.rationale: Inverse stepsize measures the scale/conditioning of the oracle gradient gain. Rare paths make its expected reciprocal exponentially large even as optimization error converges, a distinct and potentially important diagnostic phenomenon. The result covers every x0 in an open interval and all p>1. It is not a mere arbitrary numeric slice, a formatting check, or an unmotivated known-table value; it quantitatively separates typical objective improvement from mean inverse-gain behavior.
